name: Toyone (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Toyone village emblem in yellow: a disc with a pointed top enclosing a white ring.
history: Municipal flag of Toyone, a village in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 August 1972.

features.role: Toyone village emblem — a disc with a pointed top enclosing a white ring
